Kiểm soát kỹ thuật và thiết kế MEP (Cơ – Điện – Nước – HVAC – PCCC) •    Chịu trách nhiệm rà soát, đóng góp ý kiến đối với hồ sơ thiết kế các bước: ý tưởng, quy hoạch, thiết kế cơ sở, thiết kế kỹ thuật và thiết kế bản vẽ thi công. •    Chịu trách nhiệm đánh giá tính khả thi, sự phù hợp của thiết kế và các giải pháp kỹ thuật so với yêu cầu của Chủ đầu tư và quy định của pháp luật. •    Đề xuất phương án tối ưu về chất lượng và chi phí đầu tư. •    Theo dõi, đánh giá và báo cáo các rủi ro kỹ thuật phát sinh trong quá trình triển khai. •    Kiểm soát việc thi công đúng thiết kế, biện pháp thi công và tiêu chuẩn kỹ thuật được phê duyệt. •    Kiểm tra, phát hiện xung đột giữa các bộ môn trên mô hình BIM. 2. Kiểm soát tiến độ, chất lượng và nghiệm thu •    Theo dõi tiến độ các hạng mục MEP, nhận diện rủi ro chậm tiến độ và đề xuất điều chỉnh để bảo đảm tiến độ chung của dự án. •    Kiểm soát chất lượng vật tư, thiết bị đầu vào theo hồ sơ thiết kế và hợp đồng. •    Kiểm soát khối lượng thi công và hồ sơ chất lượng của nhà thầu. •    Chịu trách nhiệm phối hợp với tư vấn, nhà thầu và các bên liên quan trong công tác nghiệm thu, xử lý sai sót và hoàn thiện hồ sơ. •    Phối hợp tổ chức nghiệm thu, bàn giao theo tiêu chuẩn và tiến độ được phê duyệt. •    Kiểm soát các lỗi nghiệm thu; xử lý sự cố và hoàn thiện sản phẩm trước khi bàn giao. 3. An toàn và PCCC •    Kiểm tra, giám sát việc thực hiện các yêu cầu về an toàn điện, PCCC và an toàn lao động tại công trường. •    Theo dõi hồ sơ, nhật ký an toàn của nhà thầu. •    Đánh giá và báo cáo các rủi ro phát sinh cho quản lý trực tiếp. 4. Phối hợp và báo cáo •    Là đầu mối chuyên môn MEP của Chủ đầu tư làm việc với tư vấn thiết kế, TVGS, nhà thầu và các phòng ban liên quan. •    Báo cáo định kỳ và đột xuất về tình hình kỹ thuật, tiến độ, chất lượng và rủi ro cho quản lý trực tiếp. •    Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác theo phân công của cấp quản lý. Yêu cầu Học vấn và kinh nghiệm •    Tốt nghiệp Đại học chuyên ngành Điện, Hệ thống điện, Cấp thoát nước công trình hoặc tương đương. •    Tối thiểu 10 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực MEP; có kiến thức chuyên môn và kinh nghiệm thực tế về các bộ môn MEP tại các dự án, công trình cấp I, cấp II. •    Ưu tiên ứng viên từng làm việc phía Chủ đầu tư hoặc Ban quản lý dự án. •    Có kiến thức về và chứng chỉ về quản lý, giám sát dự án; Luật Xây dựng và các quy chuẩn, tiêu chuẩn ngành. •    Thành thạo AutoCAD, Revit, BIM 360, SketchUp, Civil 3D hoặc phần mềm tương đương. Kỹ năng & Phẩm chất •    Kỹ năng giao tiếp, phối hợp và đàm phán. •    Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề và ra quyết định. •    Kỹ năng quản lý hồ sơ và quản lý thời gian. •    Có khả năng phối hợp với TVGS, nhà thầu và các phòng ban •    Tinh thần trách nhiệm cao, Chịu được áp lực công việc. •    Trung thực, liêm chính, có tinh thần trách nhiệm và ý thức bảo vệ lợi ích của Công ty. •    Ưu tiên ứng viên có hiểu biết về ứng dụng AI trong công việc hiệu quả.

review_candidates.description: Ready to engineer your positive impact? Then join Tractebel, part of the ENGIE Group , and our 5,600 passionate experts around the globe, driven by shaping a more sustainable world every day. It’s your chance to be a part of the adventure of the century: accelerating the energy transition – while enhancing people’s lives through meaningful projects. Make your contribution to carbon neutrality in markets like nuclear, renewables, power & gas, electrical grids, hydropower & dams, water resources & supply, desalination, complex & high-tech buildings, transport infrastructures, and ports & waterways . Are you ready to make a difference? Then we look forward to meeting you! What We Offer Tractebel is more than a place to work. It’s your chance to evolve alongside top experts on impactful projects around the world. It’s an environment built on team spirit, where you can reach your highest potential. Management actively supports the development of its people, and the opportunities for growth within the ENGIE Group are wide open. At Tractebel, we value our employees and believe in rewarding hard work. Our competitive salary reflects your experience and expertise, while our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your well-being and professional growth. We understand the importance of work-life balance. That’s why we offer flexible hybrid work options, giving you the freedom to split your time between our modern offices and the comfort of your home. This approach is tailored to help you maintain productivity while enjoying a more balanced and fulfilling professional life. To celebrate our successes, and just have fun, we get together for team sports, afterworks, team -building activities, our annual party, and more. Your mission As a Structural Design Engineer in our Structural Engineering team at Tractebel, you contribute to the development of large-scale infrastructure projects, delivering innovative and efficient engineering solutions. Our team focuses on designing and optimizing infrastructure, ensuring reliability, sustainability and technical excellence to support the transition to a cleaner and more resilient future. Your Key Responsibilities You participate in projects, together with other engineers and draftsmen; You are responsible for modelling and design of various complex structures as large buildings, airports, sport centers, power projects, industrial project You occasionally visit construction sites to ensure alignment between design and execution; these visits are infrequent and short-term. You are responsible for ensuring that the hours budget, the timing and the quality of the engineering works are executed as required; You will make sure that the projects assigned to you will be executed in accordance with our quality system and our H&S rules; You participate in the structural design of your projects; You keep up with the standards, guidelines and new techniques and developments in your discipline and report these to your team members or colleagues; You respond to the requirements and needs of the client; You work together with colleagues, external partners (such as architects, other design and engineering consultancy companies, contractors during the construction phase, etc.) and clients in a constructive way; You have an international mindset and collaborate with our offices abroad for certain engineering tasks and take the necessary actions to guarantee the required quality; You actively promote and establish BIM collaboration procedures according to our company vision where applicable We would love to hear from people with Bachelor's Degree as Civil/Structural Engineer; Experience of 1-3 years; Expertise in Autocad; Expertise in Tekla represents an advantage; Good communication skills; Team player skills; Client-oriented and flexible attitude; Good knowledge of English; Who You Are You have a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. You communicate effectively and collaborate well in a team. You adapt easily to a dynamic work environment. You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges. You pay attention to detail and are committed to delivering high-quality work. Who We Are Our top priorities are people, ethics, safety, and sustainability. With Tractebel, you are uniquely positioned to make a positive impact on global net-zero targets. The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: you. Our people come first, and our strength is in our diversity. Because diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation, we welcome all applicants and remain committed to an inclusive workplace. Find out more about Tractebel, our activities and why you should join us here ! Please note - roles and responsibilities may vary or can be tailored around your expertise. At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century! review_candidates.title: Human Resources Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Namir Group, established in 2000, is a long-term-oriented company focused on sustainable growth across four core business units: industrial, engineering, financial services, and automotive, supported by an asset management arm. The Group has diversified its portfolio with investments in real estate, commodities trading, and consumer electronics to strengthen resilience and market position. Namir Group is committed to building trusted, enduring relationships with customers, employees, and partners. Integrity, transparency, and responsible growth are central to the company’s culture and long-term strategy. Role Description The Human Resources Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Ulaanbaatar Hot, Mongolia. This role oversees the full employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, learning and development, and offboarding. The Human Resources Manager will develop and implement HR policies, ensure compliance with local labor laws, and serve as a key partner to leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, and change management. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing employee relations, supporting a positive and inclusive work environment, maintaining HR records and documentation, and preparing HR reports and analytics. The role also involves coordinating compensation and benefits processes, supporting talent development programs, and driving HR initiatives that align with Namir Group’s long-term strategy and values. Qualifications Demonstrated experience in core HR functions such as recruitment, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations. Strong knowledge of Mongolian labor laws, HR compliance requirements, and best practices in workplace policies. Skills in HR planning, policy development, and implementation of HR processes and systems. Ability to handle confidential information responsibly and exercise sound judgment in decision-making. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and collaborate across diverse teams. Experience resolving conflicts, facilitating constructive feedback, and supporting inclusive workplace culture. Proficiency with HRIS and standard office software; comfort working with HR data, metrics, and reporting. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage. Prior experience as an HR Manager or in a senior HR role, preferably in multi-business or diversified organizations. Fluency in Mongolian; proficiency in English is strongly preferred for working with international partners.

Text WE ARE The European External Action Service (EEAS) is the European Union’s diplomatic service. Since 2011, the EEAS carries out the EU’s Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP) to promote peace, prosperity, security, and the interests of the EU across the globe. It brings together European civil servants, diplomats from EU Member States, national experts and local staff worldwide. The EEAS supports the High Representative in the exercise of her mandate to steer the Union’s CFSP, including the Common Security and Defence Policy (CSDP), to represent the EU on issues relating to the CFSP and to chair the Foreign Affairs Council. It also supports her as Vice-President of the Commission with regard to her responsibilities within the Commission, including the coordination of other aspects of the EU’s external action. The EEAS works in close cooperation with the EU Member States, the General Secretariat of the Council, the services of the Commission and the Secretariat General of the European Parliament. The EEAS Headquarters are in Brussels. It is also responsible for the management of the network of 145 Union Delegations and Offices worldwide. These Diplomatic Representations play a vital role in representing the EU in the country where they are based, in promoting the values and interests of the EU, and in building networks and partnerships. They are responsible for all policy areas of the relationship between the EU and the host country/organisation. The Post Management and Agility Division (RM.BHR.2) is responsible for managing posts and the organisational structure of the EEAS Headquarters and 145 EU Delegations worldwide. It oversees human resources metrics and statistics, including the publication of the annual EEAS Human Resources Report and the Staff survey, and serves as the focal point for all HR statistical reporting. It monitors geographical balance as well as gender, diversity and inclusion. The Division also manages relations with Member States, through regular meetings of the Human Resources Network and the Working Party on Staff Regulations, and with the Commission inter alia through the EUDEL Steering Committee. WE PROPOSE The position of HRM Assistant – HR Analytics and Reporting contract agent FGIIIas per article 3b of the Conditions of Employment of Other Servants of the European Union (hereafter, the “CEOS”). The successful candidate will join the post management HQ, Sysper helpdesk and data and analytics team, and focus on the development of human resources (HR) metrics and statistics in the EEAS, through high-quality data analysis, monitoring HR trends and supporting the implementation of HR policies and processes. Subject to having passed the CAST exam, the successful candidate will be offered a contract agent position (Function group III), on the basis of a contract with an initial duration of one year that may be successively renewed up to a maximum duration of six years, subject to the maximum duration of engagement by the EEAS allowed under successive limited duration contracts of different types. PLACE and DATE OF EMPLOYMENT ‎EEAS Headquarters, Brussels, Belgium Post available: 16/03/2027 LEGAL BASIS FOR RECRUITMENT TO THIS POSITION The vacancy is to be filled in accordance with the conditions stipulated under the CEOS, in particular Article 82 thereof. WE LOOK FOR Skills A dynamic, proactive, highly motivated and service-oriented colleague with excellent analytical, organisational and drafting skills. He/she will be entrusted with the following main tasks related to human resource management and reporting: Contributing to the preparation of ad-hoc statistical requests responding to the metrics needs of the EEAS, Member States and other stakeholders, including the geographical representation of EEAS staff; coordinating the preparation, publication and distribution of the annual EEAS Human Resources Report, including drafting the Human Resource Management section, consolidating contributions, performing quality checks, and overseeing document design; contributing to the EEAS Annual Activity Report (AAR) while providing accurate and validated HR figures ensuring data consistency; producing the monthly Human Resources statistical bulletin; contributing to HR exercises coordinated by central services through the preparation, extraction and delivery of statistical data and reporting materials; contributing to the preparation of the annual staff budget with figures on EEAS staff and posts; taking part in the IT development, new approaches and analytical capabilities of SYSPER HR reports (reporting tools); participating in the preparation and the follow up of the Staff Survey and the preparation of the Action Plan on the Staff Survey results within the EEAS; ensuring consistency and alignment of relevant HR data with the annual EEAS Gender Parity Report, in collaboration with the relevant counterparts. Eligibility criteria Further to the conditions set out in Article 82 of the CEOS, candidates must: have passed a valid EPSO CAST in a valid function group for this post, or be registered in the EPSO Permanent CAST in a valid function group for this post (https://eu-careers.europa.eu/en/contract-staff-selection-procedures-always-open-registration). In the latter case, while the registration will make the candidate eligible for the selection procedure, the recruitment of a candidate on this vacant post will be subject to his/her successfully passing the CAST exam; have a level of post-secondary education attested by a diploma or a level of secondary education attested by a diploma giving access to post-secondary education and appropriate professional experience of three year; have the capacity to work in the languages of the CFSP and external relations (English and French) necessary for the performance of their duties; be a national of one of the Member States of the European Union and enjoy full rights as a citizen. Selection criteria Candidates Should have strong drafting, communication and statistical and analytical skills combined with sound judgement; have at least three years of proven experience in the fields of HR management, in particular data analytics and reporting, ideally within EU institutions or international organisations; have proven strong experience in Sysper and HR Reporting tools; have a professional knowledge of Microsoft Excel and proven experience of working with complex and large-scale HR data; have experience in working in a team in a multi-disciplinary and multi-cultural environment; have demonstrated flexibility and the ability to respond to unforeseen urgencies; be fluent in English (both orally and in writing) and have a good command of French. Furthermore experience in coordinating the preparation of reports; familiarity with EU data protection rules and the use of AI tools for data analytics and reporting; will be considered an advantage. CONDITIONS OF RECRUITMENT AND EMPLOYMENT CONFLICT OF INTEREST AND SECURITY RISKS As a matter of policy, applications by individuals who have dual nationality, of which one of a non-EU country, will be considered on a case-by-case basis taking account in particular of the functions attributed to the vacant post. The EEAS also examines if there could be a conflict of interest or security risks. In this context, all candidates shall fill with their application a declaration of potential conflict of interest (see attached). MEDICAL CLEARANCE The signature of the contract will be subject to prior favourable opinion of the Medical Service, unless the successful candidate is a temporary agent currently employed in the EEAS. PERSONNEL SECURITY CLEARANCE (hereafter, “PSC”) This post is currently not identified as a post which requires Personnel Security Clearance (hereafter, the “PSC”) to access EU classified information (EUCI) in accordance with point 7 of Annex A I of the Decision ADMIN(2023) 18 on the security rules of the EEAS and as implemented by Decision ADMIN(2025) 42 on Implementing Rules and Procedures for Personnel Security measures for protection of EU Classified Information of 20 November 2025 and its implementing decisions. Nonetheless, candidates are informed that the list of posts requiring a PSC in the EEAS Headquarters is subject to regular review and that the current post might be identified in the future as a post which requires PSC. If required after the taking of duty, the selected candidate will need to be in a position to obtain a valid PSC issued by the competent authority of their Member State in accordance with national laws and regulations. In case of failure to obtain or renew the required PSC, the AACC may take the appropriate measures in accordance with Article 7 of the Decision ADMIN(2025) 42 on Implementing Rules and Procedures for Personnel Security measures for protection of EU Classified Information of 20 November 2025. Description of the EU classified information levels is available under Article 2 of Annex A of the Decision ADMIN(2023) 18 on the security rules of the EEAS. EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES The EEAS strives to be a dynamic, respectful and inclusive Service. We value the talent and professional excellence of our staff, and are committed to building an organisation where gender equality and the respect of diversity are core values, as set out in the EEAS Mission Statement and the EEAS Agenda for Diversity and Inclusion. The EEAS is committed to achieving gender balance within its workforce and strives to avoid any form of discrimination during this selection procedure, as per Article 1(d) of the SR. We actively welcome applications from all qualified candidates without any discrimination based on any ground. We commit to recruit candidates with the highest standard of ability, efficiency and integrity, carrying out a selection based on merits required for the post and from the broadest possible geographical basis among the EU Member States. The EEAS is committed to working with people with disabilities in the terms of the SR. If, by virtue of your medical condition or special needs, you require reasonable accommodation for a part or the entirety of this selection process, please send us an email to CONTRACTAGENTS-HQ@eeas.europa.eu. Your request will be treated in strict confidence and no record will be kept. If a candidate with a disability is selected for a vacant post, the EEAS is committed to providing reasonable accommodation in accordance with Article 1(d)(4) of the SR. All selected candidates are expected to adhere to the Principles of Professional Behaviour of the EEAS, which outline the need for integrity, transparency, respect, professionalism and accountability, and a zero tolerance approach to any form of harassment. APPLICATION AND SELECTION PROCEDURE Please Send Your CV And Cover Letter (with Your EPSO CAST Number), In English Or French, And The Attached Declaration Of Potential Conflict Of Interest Via Email, With Reference To The Job Number In The Subject Field, To HQ-POST-MANAGEMENT@EEAS.EUROPA.EU Deadline for sending application: 27/11/2026 at 12.00 noon (CET) . Candidates shall draft their CV using the Europass CV, which can be found at the following internet address: http://europass.cedefop.europa.eu/en/documents/curriculum-vitae. Late applications will not be accepted . The pre-selection will be done by a panel on the basis of the qualifications and the professional experience described in the CV and motivation letter. The preselected candidates who best meet the selection criteria will be invited for an interview, so that the selection panel can evaluate them objectively and impartially on the basis of their qualifications, professional experience and linguistic skills, as listed in the present vacancy notice. The selection panel may decide, subsequent to the interview, to organise written tests, either for all pre-selected candidates or to the best ranked ones. The content of such written tests will be defined by the selection panel and may include, but not be limited to, multiple choice questions, open questions and/or topics for a short essay. Pre-selected candidates without a valid CAST shall be invited to sit the CAST exam before or after the interview stage (in accordance with the eligibility criteria set out above). The panel will then recommend a shortlist of candidates for a final decision by the Authority Authorised to Conclude Contracts of Employment (hereafter, the “AACC”). If appropriate, the relevant Director, Managing Director or other senior manager of the recruiting division may conduct confirmatory interviews, prior to the final selection by the AACC. It is recalled that, if the interest of the service so requires, the selection procedure can be terminated at any stage. In the interest of the service, after identifying the candidate that best fits the requirements of the post as set out in the vacancy notice, the AACC may also establish a reserve list of candidates. The facility incorporates 12 aeroderivative gas turbine generator packages and extensive Balance of Plant electrical, instrumentation, control, communications and security infrastructure. This is an exciting project delivery role responsible for delivering the Balance of Plant scope, including engineering coordination, procurement, installation, and commissioning support. It is a practical, hands-on construction engineering role, providing day-to-day technical support to the construction teams, working under the guidance of senior and lead E&I engineers, whilst working a 2:1 FIFO/DIDO roster. Working with Monadelphous offers many benefits, some of which include: * Attractive remuneration package, including applicable site uplift and project completion benefits. * 2:1 FIFO/BIBO roster during site execution. * Opportunity to deliver major HV, LV, instrumentation and control infrastructure on a significant Queensland power project. * Work across gas turbine generators, transformers, modular electrical rooms, switchgear, plant control systems and multidisciplinary interfaces. * Exposure to the complete project lifecycle from procurement and construction planning through energisation, commissioning and handover. * A project environment where safety, quality, technical compliance and delivery accountability are central to success. Key Responsibilities: Reporting to the Senior Project Engineer and Lead Project Engineer, you will: * Work closely with the relevant engineering, procurement, project and construction management personnel, collaborating with the office-based engineering team. * Coordinate assigned EI&C construction engineering activities and supporting work front readiness. * Develop, review and maintain construction workpacks to suit construction sequencing and site requirements. * Review workpacks prepared by others, including the office engineering team for completeness and practical suitability for site execution. * Provide day-to-day technical support to construction supervisors, subcontractors and vendors. * Identify and support the resolution of field engineering issues, technical queries (RFIs/TQs) and non-conformance reports (NCRs). * Identify and resolve drawing, material, engineering and installation constraints affecting construction progress. * Support construction planning, sequencing and progress monitoring. * Coordinate technical information and requirements with the office engineering team. * Support quality assurance, installation verification, inspection and testing activities. * Support energisation, commissioning and systems completion activities. * Maintain redline drawings, as-built documentation and technical completion records. * Provide guidance and support to graduate engineers, where applicable. What you will bring - Essential: * Professional engineering qualification in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Control Systems or a related engineering discipline. * Ideally 5 or more years of relevant EI&C engineering experience. * Demonstrated industrial construction and practical site engineering experience. * Ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, cable schedules, termination drawings, loop diagrams, network architecture and vendor documentation. * Experience preparing and managing workpacks, methodologies, ITPs, ITRs, test records, RFIs, technical queries, NCRs and commissioning documentation. * Practical knowledge of HV and LV equipment, switchgear, transformers, protection systems, electrical rooms, DC systems, UPS systems, earthing and power cabling. * Experience with field instrumentation, calibration, loop checking and control-system interfaces. * Proven ability to coordinate E&I supervisors, subcontractors, technicians, vendors and specialist testing providers. * Experience in planning, progress measurement, productivity analysis, cost forecasting, subcontract administration, variations and progress claims. * Strong working knowledge of relevant Australian electrical legislation, construction requirements and quality processes. * Proof of right to work in Australia. Highly regarded: * Current RPEQ registration and CPEng accreditation. * Experience in power generation, oil and gas, or major industrial construction projects. * Experience installing and commissioning power transformers, generator step-up transformers, and modular electrical rooms. * Experience with 33kv systems, switchgear, protection relays, HV cables, earthing and energisation. * Experience with PLC, DCS, SCADA, ICMS, SIS and industrial communications networks. * Hazardous-area installation, inspection or dossier experience. * Experience supporting Queensland HV audits and electrical installation certification. Life at Monadelphous There’s lots to get involved in, celebratory or cultural events and so much more. We work hard to make Monadelphous a truly great place to work. We celebrate our diversity and shared values and are committed to inclusion and equal opportunities for all. We’re committed to hiring locally, encourage people of all diverse backgrounds to apply and strongly encourage women and First Nations people to submit an application. About us Monadelphous is an ASX-200 company providing multidisciplinary construction, maintenance and industrial services to many of the largest companies in the resources, energy and infrastructure sectors. Established in 1972, we’ve been working in Australia and around the world for more than 50 years. We work on the biggest projects and ensure our teams have a variety of opportunities available to follow their career path of choice. Our Engineering Construction division is an increasingly diverse business, focusing on managing and delivering large-scale project management and construction services. Our expertise includes civil construction, structural steel fabrication, modularisation and delivery, as well as structural, mechanical, piping and tank construction. We also specialise in heavy lift and haulage services, electrical and instrumentation work and renewable energy infrastructure. Safety is at the forefront of everything we do, and we live by our promise: The Safe Way is the Only Way. Apply now to get started. A career at Monadelphous is a career with a difference. Make it yours.
